question: A person covers 11 km at a speed of 3 km/h, 21 km at a speed of 5 km/h and 37 km at a speed of 10 km/h. Find the average speed for the entire journey.
solution:
Given:

A person covers 11 km at a speed of 3 km/h, 21 km at a speed of 5 km/h and 37 km at a speed of 10 km/h

Formula used:

Average speed = total distance/total time

Calculation:

Average speed = total distance/total time

Total distance = 11 + 21 + 37

= 69 km

Total time = (11/3) + (21/5) + (37/10)

= (110 + 126 + 111)/30 = 347/30 hours

Average speed = 69/(347/30)

= 5 (335)/(347) km/hr

∴ The average speed is 5 (335)/(347)km /hr
